def aspis_core.field.CM31.mul
  (self : aspis_core.field.CM31) (rhs : aspis_core.field.CM31) :
  Result aspis_core.field.CM31
  := do
  let m0 ← aspis_core.field.M31.mul self.a rhs.a
  let m1 ← aspis_core.field.M31.mul self.b rhs.b
  let i := self.a
  let i1 ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from i)
  let i2 := self.b
  let i3 ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from i2)

  let i6 ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from i5)
  let i7 := rhs.b
  let i8 ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from i7)
  let i9 ← lift (Std.U64.wrapping_add i6 i8)
  let i10 ← lift (Std.U64.wrapping_mul i4 i9)
  let m2 ← aspis_core.field.M31.reduce_u64 i10
  let m ← aspis_core.field.M31.sub m0 m1
  let m3 ← aspis_core.field.M31.sub m2 m0
  let m4 ← aspis_core.field.M31.sub m3 m1
  ok { a := m, b := m4 }

  let m1 ← aspis_core.field.M31.mul self.a self.b

    Name pattern: [aspis_core::field::{aspis_core::field::CM31}::inv_with]
    Visibility: public -/
@[rust_fun "aspis_core::field::{aspis_core::field::CM31}::inv_with"]
def aspis_core.field.CM31.inv_with
  (self : aspis_core.field.CM31)
  (inverse : aspis_core.field.M31 → Result aspis_core.field.M31) :
  Result aspis_core.field.CM31
  := do
  let m ← aspis_core.field.M31.mul self.a self.a
  let m1 ← aspis_core.field.M31.mul self.b self.b
  let norm ← aspis_core.field.M31.add m m1
  let inv_norm ← inverse norm
  let m2 ← aspis_core.field.M31.mul self.a inv_norm
  let m3 ← aspis_core.field.M31.neg self.b
  let m4 ← aspis_core.field.M31.mul m3 inv_norm
  ok { a := m2, b := m4 }

/-- [aspis_core::field::{aspis_core::field::CM31}::inv]:
    Source: '/home/dombarker/project-offloads/codex-pv-cblib-20261027/source/crates/aspis-core/src/field.rs', lines 390:4-390:28
    Name pattern: [aspis_core::field::{aspis_core::field::CM31}::inv]
    Visibility: public -/
@[rust_fun "aspis_core::field::{aspis_core::field::CM31}::inv"]
def aspis_core.field.CM31.inv
  (self : aspis_core.field.CM31) : Result aspis_core.field.CM31 := do
  aspis_core.field.CM31.inv_with self (aspis_core.field.M31.inv)

/-- [aspis_core::field::mul_by_r]:

@[rust_fun "aspis_core::field::mul_by_r"]
def aspis_core.field.mul_by_r
  (x : aspis_core.field.CM31) : Result aspis_core.field.CM31 := do
  let m ← aspis_core.field.M31.double x.a
  let m1 ← aspis_core.field.M31.sub m x.b
  let m2 ← aspis_core.field.M31.double x.b
  let m3 ← aspis_core.field.M31.add x.a m2
  ok { a := m1, b := m3 }

/-- [aspis_core::field::{aspis_core::field::QM31}::mul]:
    Source: '/home/dombarker/project-offloads/codex-pv-cblib-20261027/source/crates/aspis-core/src/field.rs', lines 935:4-935:39

    Visibility: public -/
@[rust_fun "aspis_core::field::{aspis_core::field::QM31}::mul"]
def aspis_core.field.QM31.mul
  (self : aspis_core.field.QM31) (rhs : aspis_core.field.QM31) :
  Result aspis_core.field.QM31
  := do
  let m0 ← aspis_core.field.CM31.mul self.c0 rhs.c0
  let m1 ← aspis_core.field.CM31.mul self.c1 rhs.c1
  let c ← aspis_core.field.CM31.add self.c0 self.c1
  let c1 ← aspis_core.field.CM31.add rhs.c0 rhs.c1
  let m2 ← aspis_core.field.CM31.mul c c1
  let c2 ← aspis_core.field.mul_by_r m1
  let c3 ← aspis_core.field.CM31.add m0 c2
  let c4 ← aspis_core.field.CM31.sub m2 m0
  let c5 ← aspis_core.field.CM31.sub c4 m1
  ok { c0 := c3, c1 := c5 }

/-- [aspis_core::field::{aspis_core::field::QM31}::square]:
    Source: '/home/dombarker/project-offloads/codex-pv-cblib-20261027/source/crates/aspis-core/src/field.rs', lines 951:4-951:31
    Name pattern: [aspis_core::field::{aspis_core::field::QM31}::square]
    Visibility: public -/
@[rust_fun "aspis_core::field::{aspis_core::field::QM31}::square"]
def aspis_core.field.QM31.square
  (self : aspis_core.field.QM31) : Result aspis_core.field.QM31 := do
  let c0_square ← aspis_core.field.CM31.square self.c0
  let c1_square ← aspis_core.field.CM31.square self.c1
  let c ← aspis_core.field.mul_by_r c1_square
  let c1 ← aspis_core.field.CM31.add c0_square c
  let c2 ← aspis_core.field.CM31.mul self.c0 self.c1
  let c3 ← aspis_core.field.CM31.double c2
  ok { c0 := c1, c1 := c3 }

@[rust_fun "aspis_core::field::{aspis_core::field::CM31}::is_zero"]
def aspis_core.field.CM31.is_zero
  (self : aspis_core.field.CM31) : Result Bool := do
  let b ← aspis_core.field.M31.is_zero self.a
  let b1 ← aspis_core.field.M31.is_zero self.b
  ok (b && b1)

def aspis_core.field.QM31.is_zero
  (self : aspis_core.field.QM31) : Result Bool := do
  let b ← aspis_core.field.CM31.is_zero self.c0
  let b1 ← aspis_core.field.CM31.is_zero self.c1
  ok (b && b1)

/-- [aspis_core::field::{aspis_core::field::QM31}::try_inv]:
    Source: '/home/dombarker/project-offloads/codex-pv-cblib-20261027/source/crates/aspis-core/src/field.rs', lines 1004:4-1004:40
    Name pattern: [aspis_core::field::{aspis_core::field::QM31}::try_inv]
    Visibility: public -/
@[rust_fun "aspis_core::field::{aspis_core::field::QM31}::try_inv"]
def aspis_core.field.QM31.try_inv
  (self : aspis_core.field.QM31) : Result (Option aspis_core.field.QM31) := do
  let b ← aspis_core.field.QM31.is_zero self
  if b
  then ok none
  else
    let c ← aspis_core.field.CM31.square self.c0
    let c1 ← aspis_core.field.CM31.square self.c1
    let c2 ← aspis_core.field.mul_by_r c1
    let norm ← aspis_core.field.CM31.sub c c2
    let inverse_norm ← aspis_core.field.CM31.inv norm
    let c3 ← aspis_core.field.CM31.mul self.c0 inverse_norm
    let c4 ← aspis_core.field.CM31.neg self.c1
    let c5 ← aspis_core.field.CM31.mul c4 inverse_norm
    ok (some { c0 := c3, c1 := c5 })

/-- [pv_alib_sampler::shipped_sampler::qm31_div_pass]: loop body 0:
    Source: '../../codex-pv-cblib-20261027/source/crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/sampler.rs', lines 11:4-16:5 -/
@[rust_loop_body]
def shipped_sampler.qm31_div_pass_loop.body
  (rank : Array Std.U32 8#usize) (remainder : Std.U64) (j : Std.Usize) :
  Result (ControlFlow ((Array Std.U32 8#usize) × Std.U64 × Std.Usize) ((Array
    Std.U32 8#usize) × Std.U64))
  := do
  if j > 0#usize
  then
    let j1 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_sub j 1#usize)
    let i ← lift (Std.U64.wrapping_shl remainder 32#i32)
    let i1 ← Array.index_usize rank j1
    let i2 ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from i1)
    let dividend ← lift (i ||| i2)
    let i3 ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from aspis_core.field.P)
    let i4 ← dividend / i3
    let i5 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U32 i4)
    let rank1 ← Array.update rank j1 i5
    let i6 ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from aspis_core.field.P)
    let remainder1 ← dividend % i6
    ok (cont (rank1, remainder1, j1))
  else ok (done (rank, remainder))

/-- [pv_alib_sampler::shipped_sampler::qm31_div_pass]: loop 0:

  Result ((Array Std.U32 8#usize) × Std.U64)
  := do
  loop
    (fun (rank1, remainder1, j1) => shipped_sampler.qm31_div_pass_loop.body
      rank1 remainder1 j1)
    (rank, remainder, j)

/-- [pv_alib_sampler::shipped_sampler::qm31_div_pass]:
    Source: '../../codex-pv-cblib-20261027/source/crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/sampler.rs', lines 8:0-18:1 -/
def shipped_sampler.qm31_div_pass
  (rank : Array Std.U32 8#usize) :
  Result ((Array Std.U32 8#usize) × Std.U32)
  := do
  let (rank1, remainder) ←
    shipped_sampler.qm31_div_pass_loop rank 0#u64 8#usize
  let i ← lift (UScalar.cast .U32 remainder)
  ok (rank1, i)

/-- [pv_alib_sampler::shipped_sampler::qm31_digits]: loop body 0:
    Source: '../../codex-pv-cblib-20261027/source/crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/sampler.rs', lines 24:4-33:5 -/
@[rust_loop_body]
def shipped_sampler.qm31_digits_loop0.body
  (block : Array Std.U8 32#usize) (rank : Array Std.U32 8#usize)
  (i : Std.Usize) :
  Result (ControlFlow ((Array Std.U32 8#usize) × Std.Usize) (Array Std.U32
    8#usize))
  := do
  if i < 8#usize
  then
    let start ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize i)
    let i1 ← Array.index_usize block start
    let i2 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add start 1#usize)
    let i3 ← Array.index_usize block i2
    let i4 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add start 2#usize)
    let i5 ← Array.index_usize block i4
    let i6 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add start 3#usize)
    let i7 ← Array.index_usize block i6
    let i8 ←
      lift (core.num.U32.from_le_bytes (Array.make 4#usize [ i1, i3, i5, i7 ]))
    let rank1 ← Array.update rank i i8
    let i9 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize)
    ok (cont (rank1, i9))
  else ok (done rank)

/-- [pv_alib_sampler::shipped_sampler::qm31_digits]: loop body 1:

@[rust_loop_body]
def shipped_sampler.qm31_digits_loop1.body
  (rank : Array Std.U32 8#usize) (digits : Array Std.U32 4#usize)
  (i : Std.Usize) :
  Result (ControlFlow ((Array Std.U32 8#usize) × (Array Std.U32 4#usize) ×
    Std.Usize) (Array Std.U32 4#usize))
  := do
  if i < 4#usize
  then
    let (quotient, digit) ← shipped_sampler.qm31_div_pass rank
    let digits1 ← Array.update digits i digit
    let i1 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize)
    ok (cont (quotient, digits1, i1))
  else ok (done digits)

/-- [pv_alib_sampler::shipped_sampler::qm31_digits]:
    Source: '../../codex-pv-cblib-20261027/source/crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/sampler.rs', lines 21:0-43:1 -/
def shipped_sampler.qm31_digits
  (block : Array Std.U8 32#usize) : Result (Array Std.U32 4#usize) := do
  let rank := Array.repeat 8#usize 0#u32
  let rank1 ← shipped_sampler.qm31_digits_loop0 block rank 0#usize
  let digits := Array.repeat 4#usize 0#u32
  shipped_sampler.qm31_digits_loop1 rank1 digits 0#usize

/-- [pv_alib_sampler::shipped_sampler::qm31_sample]:
    Source: '../../codex-pv-cblib-20261027/source/crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/sampler.rs', lines 45:0-51:1
    Visibility: public -/
def shipped_sampler.qm31_sample
  (block : Array Std.U8 32#usize) : Result aspis_core.field.QM31 := do
  let digits ← shipped_sampler.qm31_digits block
  let i ← Array.index_usize digits 0#usize
  let i1 ← Array.index_usize digits 1#usize
  let c ← aspis_core.field.CM31.new i i1
  let i2 ← Array.index_usize digits 2#usize
  let i3 ← Array.index_usize digits 3#usize
  let c1 ← aspis_core.field.CM31.new i2 i3
  ok { c0 := c, c1 }

/-- [pv_alib_sampler::map_parameter]:
    Source: 'sampler-owned-reference.rs', lines 8:0-22:1
    Visibility: public -/
def map_parameter
  (parameter1 : aspis_core.field.QM31) :
  Result (core.result.Result aspis_core.circle.SecureCirclePoint
    aspis_core.circle.CirclePointError)
  := do
  let square ← aspis_core.field.QM31.square parameter1
  let q ← aspis_core.field.QM31.add aspis_core.field.QM31.ONE square
  let o ← aspis_core.field.QM31.try_inv q
  match o with
  | none =>
    ok (core.result.Result.Err
      aspis_core.circle.CirclePointError.SingularParameter)
  | some value =>
    let q1 ← aspis_core.field.QM31.sub aspis_core.field.QM31.ONE square
    let q2 ← aspis_core.field.QM31.mul q1 value
    let q3 ← aspis_core.field.QM31.add parameter1 parameter1
    let q4 ← aspis_core.field.QM31.mul q3 value
    let b ←
      aspis_core.field.CM31.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqCM31.eq parameter1.c1
        aspis_core.field.CM31.ZERO
    if b
    then
      ok (core.result.Result.Err
        aspis_core.circle.CirclePointError.ParameterInCm31Subfield)
    else ok (core.result.Result.Ok { x := q2, y := q4 })

/-- [pv_alib_sampler::FALLBACK]
    Source: 'sampler-owned-reference.rs', lines 24:0-27:2
    Visibility: public -/
@[global_simps, irreducible]
def FALLBACK : Array aspis_core.field.QM31 2#usize :=
  Array.make 2#usize [
    { c0 := aspis_core.field.CM31.ZERO, c1 := aspis_core.field.CM31.ONE },
    { c0 := aspis_core.field.CM31.ONE, c1 := aspis_core.field.CM31.ONE }
    ]

/-- [pv_alib_sampler::fallback]:
    Source: 'sampler-owned-reference.rs', lines 28:0-34:1
    Visibility: public -/
def fallback
  (sample : Std.Usize) : Result aspis_core.circle.SecureCirclePoint := do
  let i ← sample % 2#usize
  let parameter1 ← Array.index_usize FALLBACK i
  let r ← map_parameter parameter1
  match r with
  | core.result.Result.Ok point => ok point
  | core.result.Result.Err _ =>
    ok { x := aspis_core.field.QM31.ONE, y := aspis_core.field.QM31.ZERO }

/-- [pv_alib_sampler::circle_owned]:
    Source: 'sampler-owned-reference.rs', lines 35:0-44:1
    Visibility: public -/
def circle_owned
  (block : Array Std.U8 32#usize) (row : aspis_core.r0_transcript.CircleRow) :
  Result aspis_core.circle.SecureCirclePoint
  := do
  let parameter1 ← shipped_sampler.qm31_sample block
  let r ← map_parameter parameter1
  match r with
  | core.result.Result.Ok point => ok point
  | core.result.Result.Err _ =>
    match row with
    | aspis_core.r0_transcript.CircleRow.First => fallback 0#usize
    | aspis_core.r0_transcript.CircleRow.Second => fallback 1#usize

end PV_AL_CircleOwned
